findings.evidence: Line 57 `[(t.rationalRootSystem ht).IsNotG2]` is the only type hypothesis. Lines 191-192 rebuild that instance from `hBC` (`obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := hBC <;> infer_instance`) and do nothing else with `hBC`.
findings.fix: Make the `IsNotG2` form public, either as this element-level lemma or folded into the subgroup-level theorem below, and place it in a type-agnostic `Collection` module rather than `BC.lean`.
findings.issue: `commutator_mem_higher_roots` is `private`, but its only type assumption is `[(t.rationalRootSystem ht).IsNotG2]`. It is the general height-raising result that the simply-laced and F₄ collection PRs also need, so hiding it invites duplicates.

findings.evidence: Line 179 `(hBC : ∃ n, t = B n ∨ t = C n)`. `hBC` has no other use in the proof. NotG2.lean adds the instances for `(B n)` and `(C n)` at every valid rank.
findings.fix: Replace `hBC` with `[(t.rationalRootSystem ht).IsNotG2]` and drop the `_of_typeBC` suffix. The new `instIsNotG2RationalRootSystemB`/`C` instances discharge it automatically for B/C.
findings.issue: `commutator_range_chevalleyRootSubgroup_le_of_typeBC` takes the existential `hBC : ∃ n, t = B n ∨ t = C n`, which is used only to synthesize `IsNotG2`. Callers who already have the instance (A, D, E, F₄, or B/C through the new instances) still have to supply a B/C witness.

findings.evidence: Line 200 `(hBC : ∃ n, t = B n ∨ t = C n)`. Its only use is forwarding to the commutator theorem at line 215.
findings.fix: State it under `[(t.rationalRootSystem ht).IsNotG2]` with a type-agnostic name, for example `mem_iSup_positive_root_ranges_iff`.
findings.issue: `mem_iSup_positive_root_ranges_iff_of_typeBC` has the same problem: `hBC` is passed through only to reach the `IsNotG2` bound.

summary: The real reusable result, a commutator height bound and ordered-product collection for any root system with an `[IsNotG2]` instance, is kept private, and the public surface is narrowed to B/C through an ad-hoc `hBC : ∃ n, t = B n ∨ t = C n` hypothesis. Expose the `IsNotG2`-generic forms instead; B/C clients get them through the new instances.
